summary: Phase 41 S6.A retest. Backend P1 #1 (news_radio RJ script) FIX VALIDATED: /api/radio/next no longer 500s on news_anchor segments; rj_script returns 200, contains 'BigFM News', does NOT contain 'BigFM Dubai', track_id is null, kind='news_anchor'. Earnings backend smoke endpoints all pass (200 for owner, 403 for non-owner). Frontend: desktop sidebar News/Community OK, /radio Community strip OK with 8 cards, Earnings tab on /r/p41-audit-test fully renders for owner (Stripe MOCKED linked, $255.39 7d / $2378.05 lifetime, 24 ledger rows, all 5 source breakdowns: Banner ads / Audio ads / Premium listens / Tips / Direct deals, 7d/30d/90d/All-time pills), non-owner correctly blocked. ONE GAP: Mobile More overflow drawer does NOT expose data-testid='overflow-news' / 'overflow-community' — the drawer renders only admin shortcuts (Creator Studio, Advertiser dashboard, Admin console). One intermittent /api/radio/start 500 ('NoneType' is not subscriptable) seen once, succeeded on retry — flaky cold-start path, not blocking.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500: TypeError 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable on cold-start path; succeeds on retry. Reproduced once in 6 attempts during this iteration. Trace lands in cache_middleware → router; probably a None guard missing on a track field during the cold build.

ui_bugs.component: AppShell mobile overflow drawer (More bottom tab)
ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires data-testid='overflow-news' and data-testid='overflow-community' inside the mobile More drawer. Neither exists. The drawer currently surfaces only Creator/Advertiser/Admin shortcuts; News and Community are absent on mobile, so a mobile user cannot reach /news or /community from the bottom nav.

action_items: Add News + Community entries to the mobile overflow drawer in AppShell.jsx with data-testid='overflow-news' and data-testid='overflow-community', routing to /news and /community respectively. Make sure they appear for ALL roles (admin, creator, plain listener) the same way the desktop sidebar More section does.

Optional/P2: Harden /api/radio/start cold-build path for news_radio against the intermittent 'NoneType' subscript error (single repro out of multiple runs; likely a missing None-guard on a track or RJ field).
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile parity gap: SECONDARY_NAV (desktop) now includes News + Community but the mobile overflow drawer (bottom-tab-more sheet) was not updated in the same iteration. Keep these two lists in lockstep.

Console keeps emitting 'props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (NavItem, BottomTab) — non-blocking but indicates a {...item} spread that also passes `key`. Move `key` out of the spread.

Backend cold-start news_radio path: previous iteration's /next KeyError is fixed (good), but the new intermittent 'NoneType' subscript suggests another None-guard is still missing one layer up (in /start). Add the same .get()/short-circuit treatment used in /next.

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow drawer (rendered when the bottom-tab-more is tapped) is built from a separate list inside AppShell.jsx — not the SECONDARY_NAV array that was updated for desktop. The desktop fix at line 60+ added News/Community to SECONDARY_NAV, but the mobile drawer source array (admin/creator/advertiser shortcuts only) was not amended in the same change, so News + Community never reach the mobile UI. Mitigation: extract a single shared array of secondary items (or push News+Community into the mobile drawer items array) and render both with data-testid='overflow-news' / 'overflow-community'.
